canonical_identity.title: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari

scope.relevance: Describes collection/processing of Mundari text and speech and an end-to-end TTS system; relevant to audiovisual/dataset census and provenance reconciliation.

deduplication.rule: Article/preprint identity is distinct from dataset identity; link them only through explicit provenance rather than title/language similarity.

locator_policy.future_exact_locator: immutable arXiv version + PDF page/section/table/figure or dataset-file/utterance identifier, as applicable
locator_policy.promotion_state: exact source locator recorded; passage/utterance evidence not promoted

rights_access_consent.reuse: not inferred from public availability; manifestation-level terms require verification
rights_access_consent.participant_consent: not established by publication or dataset availability
rights_access_consent.privacy: speaker-level provenance/privacy review required before audiovisual evidence promotion
rights_access_consent.cultural_access: unknown; must be preserved as uncertainty
rights_access_consent.restriction_policy: do not expose or redistribute underlying audio/text unless source rights, participant consent and cultural-access conditions support it

evidence_promotion.reason: Abstract establishes research scope but is insufficient for exact passage/utterance evidence, rights, speaker consent, and provenance audit.

open_gaps: materialize a permitted immutable article manifestation and record SHA-256
verify publication/version metadata and PDF page concordance
reconcile the paper's corpus description against the separately registered Karya Mundari TTS dataset without assuming identity
audit speaker/collector/translator provenance, consent, privacy and cultural-access conditions
promote only supported permitted exact-locator evidence after those checks
controlled_count_effect: none until deterministic reconciliation against WEB-MUN ledger
